description: Counterexamples kept as deterministic regression fixtures. `cargo xtask check-counterexamples` requires each reproducer test to exist in its file and each fix commit to exist. Removing an entry is a trust-boundary change.

counterexamples.origin: Review of final receipt validation after hosted fuzz drift failure 38151336752
counterexamples.defect: The final validator checked pre-check dirty flags but never inspected the live worktree, so a last check could change inputs after its receipt context was captured
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: freeze a real Git fixture, then change a tracked input or add an untracked input after the recorded identity; final validation must reject both

counterexamples.origin: Hosted extended run 38151336752 on proposed merge e35fdf9: all commands exited zero, but dependency-policy and coverage receipts were dirty after fuzzing
counterexamples.defect: The separate fuzz lock lacked the current server dependency graph; cargo-fuzz silently rewrote it, so later checks did not run on unchanged candidate inputs
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: cargo metadata --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --locked --offline at eb5b096 exits 101; stale-lock and mid-trial rewrite controls reproduce the required rejection

counterexamples.origin: October 11 isolated mutation audit after the relational query reference was added
counterexamples.defect: Existing cases did not reject pruning a source whose maximum timestamp equals the cursor timestamp but whose full row keys are later
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: two rows at time 20 with identities 1 and 2, after cursor at time 20 with identity 0; max < cursor.time changed to == or <= in both walks
counterexamples.contract: HIST-4 continuation keys must never skip matching rows

counterexamples.origin: October 11 release integration review; retained contaminated audit and isolated rerun in the research wiki
counterexamples.defect: Parallel mutated source copies reused one absolute Cargo target, allowing a worker to test an executable for another mutation
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: cargo-mutants-opt1: tested counter deltas survived; per-worker logs named the same compiler output directory
counterexamples.contract: ADR-0018 executable evidence must correspond to the proposed source

counterexamples.defect: The existing tests did not reject lower-bound comparison mutations which turn an unchanged exact i64 minimum counter into a reset
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: query.rs:146:15 < changed to == or <=; Int(i64::MIN) followed by its exact Double representation
counterexamples.contract: HIST-6 unchanged uninterrupted counters produce zero rate

counterexamples.defect: The existing tests did not reject a mutation dropping a newly added forward credential binding after index promotion
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: delivery.rs:178:27 != changed to ==; 34 distinct credentials followed by rebinding and intrusion attempts
counterexamples.contract: DEL-5 one credential binds to one Spindle in either direction

counterexamples.defect: Btrfs changed runtime st_dev from 51 to 32 across reboot; the old raw-device comparison reread three already committed lines at unchanged inode 2505 and source offsets
